sloka: महत् धरण्या विवरम् प्रविष्टाः स्म पिपासिताः ।इमाम् तु एवम् विधान् भावान् विविधान् अद्भुत उपमान् ॥४-५१-३॥
transliteration: mahat dharaṇyā vivaram praviṣṭāḥ sma pipāsitāḥ ।imām tu evam vidhān bhāvān vividhān adbhuta upamān ॥4-51-3॥

translations.english: 'Thirst drove us into this cave on earth. We are amazed at the kind of many wonderful objects here and have nearly lost our senses. We are tormented with pain.
